name: RLHF reward and KL terms
description: One scores the answer, one limits drift

data.noteContent:
RLHF tunes a pretrained model with two pieces, and this graph runs them side by side: a reward model that scores an answer, and a KL term that stops the policy running away from the model it started as. They are kept independent so each can be read on its own; inside PPO the quantity being maximised is the reward minus beta times the KL. Both halves run on stand-in tensors -- no language model is loaded, and nothing is trained, so the numbers are shapes rather than results.

RLHF 用兩樣東西調整預訓練模型，這張圖把它們並排跑：一個是給答案打分數的獎勵模型，一個是不讓策略跑離原本模型太遠的 KL 項。這裡刻意讓兩邊各自獨立，方便分開讀；在 PPO 裡真正被最大化的，是獎勵減掉 beta 乘上 KL。兩邊用的都是替代張量 — 沒有載入任何語言模型，也沒有訓練，所以數字看的是形狀，不是結果。

The reward half. RewardModel is the head you would put on a frozen language model and train on pairs of human-ranked answers: hidden states in, one scalar out per sequence. The input here is a random [4, 16] batch, so the four scores mean nothing -- that there is exactly one per sequence is the point.

這是獎勵那一半。RewardModel 就是接在凍結語言模型上、拿人類排序過的答案配對去訓練的那顆頭：吃 hidden state，每條序列吐一個純量。這裡的輸入是隨機的 [4, 16]，所以四個分數沒有意義 — 重點是每條序列剛好一個。

The KL half. p is the policy's logits and q the frozen reference's, all zeros here, which is the uniform distribution. batchmean is the RLHF convention: the sum divided by the batch size. KL is not symmetric, so which tensor goes into p is a decision, not a detail.

這是 KL 那一半。p 是策略的 logits，q 是凍結參考模型的 logits，這裡全部是 0，也就是均勻分布。batchmean 是 RLHF 的慣例：總和除以批次大小。KL 不對稱，所以哪個張量接到 p 是要想過的，不是小細節。
